opening.argument: The video presents RoyalQ as an automated trading route tied to making money, while requiring viewers to pay for activation and supply trading access. It says the app is a robot that receives instructions and trades, and directs viewers to “Fund Royal Q with $120 (USDT) TRC20 NETWORK and Activate for 1 year.” It further connects synchronized robot settings with starting to make money, and requires Binance registration with government-issued ID verification. The promotion extends beyond personal trading: viewers are told they can earn commissions from the daily trading profits of people in their team across successive levels and generations. Those displayed profit and team dashboards reinforce the offer, although the records do not establish settled figures or delivery of the claimed returns, and the video includes personal-experience and research disclaimers.
